job.title: AI Engineer
job.description:
A well-known organisation in the financial services & insurance space is seeking a hands-on AI Engineer. You be joining a small, well-credentialed AI team that's already shipping generative AI and applied ML into real business problems across their business units and customers.

The Role
  • Design and build AI-driven features and services, from predictive models to generative AI applications
  • Develop and operationalise solutions using large language models, including prompt engineering, orchestration and evaluation
  • Build AI-enabled APIs and services that plug into customer-facing and internal systems
  • Apply techniques such as NLP, classification, recommendation and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
  • Embed explainability, human-in-the-loop controls and responsible AI practices into everything you build
  • Work closely with data scientists, ML engineers and business stakeholders to turn use cases into production-grade AI capability
What You'll Bring
Must-haves:
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java or TypeScript
  • 3+ years across software engineering, AI engineering or applied machine learning
  • Practical experience with APIs, microservices and cloud-native architecture
  • Hands-on work with LLM platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic or open-source models
  • Solid grasp of prompt engineering, RAG architectures and evaluation techniques
  • A good understanding of data privacy, compliance and responsible AI
Nice to haves:
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated environment
  • Understanding of the end-to-end ML lifecycle (training, deployment, monitoring)
Why This Role
This is a small team with real scope to shape how AI gets built and used across the business, working directly with data, security, and platform teams. You'll get exposure across the full AI lifecycle, from prototype through to production, in an organisation that's investing seriously in the space.

How to Apply
Apply now, or reach out to Bruce Batters at Momentum Consulting for a confidential chat: bruce.batters@momentum.co.nz

To be considered for this role you must hold New Zealand working rights. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship.

job.title: ML Engineer / Senior ML Engineer
job.description:
A well-known organisation in the financial services & insurance space is building out its MLOps capability and needs someone to own the path from trained model to production system.

The Role
  • Productionise machine learning models built by data scientists, ensuring robustness, scalability and performance
  • Design feature pipelines, model training workflows and inference services
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for ML models, covering training, testing, deployment and monitoring
  • Implement model versioning, experiment tracking and reproducibility standards
  • Set up monitoring for model performance, drift, data quality and operational health
  • Operate ML workloads on cloud platforms, with containerisation and orchestration where it makes sense
  • Embed responsible AI practices, including explainability and bias monitoring, in a regulated environment
What You'll Bring
Must-haves:
  • Over 3 years in ML engineering, MLOps, or software/data engineering with ML in production
  • Strong Python skills (familiarity across scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch or XGBoost is preferred)
  • Experience building and operating ML pipelines in a production environment
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: testing, CI/CD, version control
  • Experience with cloud platforms and managed ML services
Nice to haves:
  • Background in financial services or insurance
  • Familiarity with MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI or Azure ML
  • Exposure to model explainability techniques such as SHAP or LIME
Why This Role
You'll sit right at the intersection of data science, engineering and cloud, with a direct hand in how AI gets deployed and trusted across the business. It's a role for someone pragmatic and delivery-focused who wants ownership of the platform, not just the pipeline.

How to Apply
Apply now, or reach out to Bruce Batters at Momentum Consulting for a confidential chat: bruce.batters@momentum.co.nz

job.title: IT Sales Account Manager

  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with customers to encourage loyalty and long-term retention

Essential:

  • The ability to juggle multiple customer accounts without dropping the ball
  • A knack for spotting growth opportunities within existing accounts
Nice to have:
  • Experience in managed services, technology, or telecommunications
  • Familiarity with MSP agreements or service delivery environments
If this sounds like your kind of role, APPLY today!

job.title: Change Practice Lead - Digital
job.description:
• Shape change strategy, readiness and adoption across complex transformation initiatives
  • Establish and lead a high-performing Change Practice and Centre of Excellence
  • Practice leadership and hands-on change delivery
We’re looking for an experienced Change Practice Lead to establish, lead and continuously improve change management capability within a large, complex organisation.

This is a senior role combining change practice leadership, portfolio-level oversight, capability development and hands-on change delivery. You’ll define what great change looks like, build consistency across the portfolio and help ensure people are ready and able to successfully adopt new ways of working.

About the role
You’ll take ownership of the Change Practice and Centre of Excellence, developing the frameworks, standards, tools and ways of working that support effective change across a broad portfolio of digital and transformation initiatives.

You’ll work closely with senior leaders, sponsors and delivery teams to ensure change impacts, readiness, adoption risks and benefits are considered from the outset and integrated into delivery planning.

You’ll be responsible for:
  • Establishing and developing the Change Practice and Centre of Excellence.
  • Defining change standards, frameworks, templates, playbooks and ways of working.
  • Building consistency across change impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, business readiness and adoption planning.
  • Providing an enterprise view of cumulative change impacts, dependencies, readiness and adoption risk.
  • Coaching and mentoring Change Managers and other change practitioners.
  • Partnering with portfolio and delivery leaders to embed change into planning, governance and decision-making.
  • Supporting benefits realisation through effective adoption and sustainment planning.
  • Building a strong change community that encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Turning lessons learnt into practical improvements across the change practice.
  • Personally leading change activities across selected complex or high-impact transformation initiatives.
About you
You’ll be an experienced change leader who has moved beyond delivering change on individual projects and can demonstrate experience building or significantly uplifting change capability at a broader organisational level.

Ideally, you’ll bring:
  • 10+ years’ experience across change management, transformation or delivery enablement.
  • Proven experience establishing or significantly uplifting a Change Practice, Community of Practice or Centre of Excellence.
  • Strong experience working across complex digital, technology or business transformation environments.
  • Experience working with senior executives, sponsors and business leaders to shape change strategy, readiness and adoption.
  • The ability to identify and communicate cumulative change impacts across multiple initiatives.
  • Strong coaching and mentoring capability, with experience developing change practitioners.
  • Strong stakeholder management, influencing, facilitation and negotiation skills.
  • Experience across both Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.
  • Experience with adoption measurement, benefits realisation and operational readiness.
  • A pragmatic approach – able to establish consistency without introducing unnecessary process or overhead.

This is an opportunity to shape how change is delivered across an organisation, building capability and consistency while remaining close enough to delivery to see the impact of your work.

job.title: Junior Commercial Analyst
job.description:
Are you an analytical thinker who loves working with numbers, spotting trends, and turning data into insight? This is a genuine opportunity to build a career in commercial finance with a well-established, values-driven organisation.

You won't just be crunching numbers; you'll be mentored into a role that shapes real pricing, planning and business performance decisions at a senior level. If you're early in your finance career (or studying towards CA/CPA) and want hands-on exposure to commercial accounting rather than routine transactional work, this is designed for you.

You'll start by supporting the team with data collection, reporting and analysis, and progressively take on more responsibility as your confidence and skills develop:
  • Help collect, compile and analyse pricing, sales and market data to support management decision-making
  • Assist in maintaining pricing systems, ensuring data is accurate and reliable
  • Support the preparation of management reports and business performance reviews
  • Get involved in budgeting, forecasting and CAPEX planning processes

  • Work alongside experienced commercial and finance professionals who'll actively coach you
What We're Looking For
  • A relevant tertiary qualification in accounting, finance, commerce or a related field (recent graduate or early-career welcome)
  • Currently working towards, or keen to start, your CA/CPA pathway
  • Strong Excel/MS Office skills and a genuine curiosity for working with data
  • Naturally analytical; you enjoy digging into numbers to find the "why"
  • Good communicator who can explain findings simply, without jargon
  • A collaborative attitude, balanced with the ability to work independently once trained
  • Eager to learn new systems, processes and different parts of the business
Why This Role
  • Real mentorship and a clear runway to grow into a fully-fledged Commercial Accountant position
  • Exposure across pricing, planning, forecasting, budgeting and business performance; not just one narrow function
  • Join a business with strong values 
  • A team environment where good ideas are heard and acted on
If you're looking for more than a "process the invoices" junior role, somewhere that will genuinely invest in developing your commercial acumen, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Senior Project Manager - Operating Model implementation
job.description:

Reporting to senior business owners, you'll drive an evidence-based investigation that builds on existing assurance and due diligence work already completed, to shape recommendations that make the scheme more efficient, effective and robust.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead and coordinate an end-to-end investigation into future operating model options, following confirmation of scope, purpose and policy/funding parameters.
  • Assess the respective roles and responsibilities of the key parties and agencies involved in delivering the scheme.
  • Review existing technology systems and administrative arrangements supporting the scheme, and capture lessons learnt to date.
  • Evaluate governance, accountability, procurement and funding settings.
  • Undertake comparative analysis of operating models used in other jurisdictions.
  • Define success measures across customer experience, investment, and scheme integrity.
  • Develop requirements for an administration system to support future operational delivery, including input into an investment case / proof of concept.
  • Manage project scope, timelines, stakeholder engagement and reporting to ensure the project delivers agreed outcomes.
  • Work closely with senior business owners to keep the investigation aligned to agreed objectives.
About You
  • Proven experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder investigations or reviews, ideally within government or public sector environments.
  • Strong understanding of operating model design, governance frameworks, and procurement/funding arrangements.
  • Skilled at synthesising input from audits, due diligence reviews and technical assessments into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior leaders and cross-agency partners.
  • Strong analytical and report-writing skills, with experience developing business or investment cases.
  • Comfortable operating within a structured PMO environment, reporting into a programme management office.
  • Relevant project management qualification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile) is an advantage.
What's on Offer
  • A high-impact, hourly rate project role shaping the future of a nationally significant scheme.
  • The opportunity to work alongside experienced senior leaders across strategic policy, operations, and programme delivery.
  • A defined, outcomes-focused engagement running October 2026 – February 2027.
How to Apply If you have the project leadership experience and public sector insight to drive this investigation forward, we'd love to hear from you. Click Apply Now to submit your CV, or contact the Momentum Consulting team for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Data & AI Governance Lead
job.description:
As AI adoption accelerates across this business, someone needs to make sure it scales responsibly. This is a newly created leadership role at a well known New Zealand financial services organisation that has spent the last six months building out a genuinely capable AI function, and now needs an experienced governance lead to build the frameworks that let the business move fast without losing control. 

You will not be running the AI use cases yourself. You will be the person who makes sure they are governed properly, from data quality through to responsible AI oversight. 

The Role 
  • Develop and operationalise enterprise data and AI governance frameworks, policies, standards and controls 
  • Lead data quality, metadata, lineage, ownership and stewardship initiatives across business domains 
  • Govern AI and advanced analytics across the full lifecycle, including use case assessment, testing, human oversight, monitoring and incident management 
  • Partner closely with technical delivery teams, the AI function and enterprise Risk and Compliance 
  • Prepare governance reporting and evidence for senior forums, assurance providers, auditors or regulators 
  • Work closely alongside the AI Delivery Lead to keep data and AI initiatives aligned and well governed 
What You'll Bring 

Must haves: 
  • 7+ years' experience in data governance, information governance, AI governance, privacy, risk, compliance, data management or a related discipline 
  • Demonstrated experience developing and operationalising enterprise governance frameworks, policies, standards and controls 
  • Practical experience leading data quality, metadata, lineage, ownership, stewardship or data access initiatives 
  • Experience governing AI or advanced analytics across the lifecycle, including testing, human oversight, monitoring and incident management 
  • Experience partnering with technical delivery teams and Risk or Compliance functions 
  • Experience preparing governance reporting for senior forums, auditors or regulators 
Nice to haves: 
  • Experience in insurance, financial services or another regulated, operationally complex environment (strongly preferred) 
  • Data governance, privacy, risk, assurance or responsible AI certifications 
Why This Role 

This organisation is NZ owned, ambitious and moving quickly, with the governance in place to back it up. The AI team is genuinely well credentialed, with people drawn from Microsoft, the banks and Spark, and it is growing fast, which means this role has real influence over how that growth happens. You will get real investment in your own development too, including relevant certifications, Snowflake training and access to a dedicated leadership programme for people managing direct reports.
